roadmap.title: Prologue and Norway
roadmap.description: Complete the prologue and the Norwegian story, then set sail for England.

roadmap.title: Grantebridgescire arc
roadmap.description: Pledge to Grantebridgescire and complete its story arc, including unmasking Soma's traitor.

roadmap.title: East Anglia arc
roadmap.description: Pledge to East Anglia and complete its story arc after the attack on Ravensthorpe.

roadmap.title: Lunden arc
roadmap.description: Build the Hidden Ones Bureau, then complete the Lunden arc and meet the Order of the Ancients.

roadmap.title: Cent arc
roadmap.description: Pledge to Cent and complete its story arc alongside Basim.

roadmap.title: Suthsexe arc
roadmap.description: Pledge to Suthsexe and complete its story arc against the Saxon and Order forces.

roadmap.title: Wincestre arc
roadmap.description: Pledge to Wincestre and complete its story arc.

roadmap.title: Asgard and Jotunheim
roadmap.description: Build the Seer's Hut and complete the mythological story arcs in Asgard and Jotunheim.

roadmap.title: The Prophecy and Hamtunscire
roadmap.description: Pledge to Hordafylke for the final Norway storyline and complete the Hamtunscire arc to end the story.

roadmap.title: Settling and raiding
roadmap.description: Raid your first monastery and grow Ravensthorpe by building settlement structures, including the Barracks and your first Jomsviking.

roadmap.title: World completion
roadmap.description: Complete every Wealth, Mystery, and Artifact in Norway, England, Asgard, Jotunheim, and Vinland, including Orlog players and Legendary Animals.

roadmap.title: Order of the Ancients and Vinland
roadmap.description: Eliminate all 45 Order of the Ancients targets, report to Hytham, and travel to Vinland.

roadmap.title: Base-game cleanup
roadmap.description: Finish the remaining base-game feats, settlement rewards, legendary weapons, and skill milestones.

roadmap.title: Wrath of the Druids (Ireland)
roadmap.description: Complete the Ireland expansion: campaign, Children of Danu, Dublin Renown, Royal Demands, and collectibles.

roadmap.title: The Siege of Paris (Francia)
roadmap.description: Complete the Francia expansion: campaign, Rebel Missions, Frankish Nobles, collectibles, and cats.

roadmap.title: Dawn of Ragnarök (Svartalfheim)
roadmap.description: Complete the Svartalfheim expansion: campaign, Hugr-Rip, Shelters, collectibles, and powers.

roadmap.title: The Forgotten Saga (Niflheim)
roadmap.description: Complete the roguelite expansion: quests, encounters, bosses, favours, and kills.

roadmap.title: Mastery Challenges and Tombs of the Fallen
roadmap.description: Earn Gold medals in every Mastery Challenge trial and complete every Tomb of the Fallen.

achievements.description: Finish the opening prologue in Norway.
achievements.summary: Complete the prologue, up to the choice of Eivor's gender.

steps.text: Play the opening missions in Norway and follow the story until the prologue ends with the choice of Eivor's gender.

achievements.description: Set out from Norway and arrive in England.
achievements.summary: Leave Norway for England during the main story.

guide.context: The Norwegian story takes place in Rygjafylke and Hordafylke. The Raven Clan armor set can be gathered from Norway's wealth before you sail.

steps.text: Finish the Norway questline, then sail to England with Sigurd when the story sends you.

achievements.description: Complete the Grantebridgescire story arc.
achievements.summary: Complete the Grantebridgescire story arc.

guide.context: Near the end of the arc, the quest "The Stench of Treachery" asks you to name the traitor among Soma's men. The traitor is Gallin.

steps.text: Pledge to @loc{Grantebridgescire} at the alliance map and complete its story missions.
During "The Stench of Treachery", accuse @npc{Gallin} of being the traitor.

achievements.description: Finish the Lunden arc of the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete the Lunden story arc.

guide.context: The @loc{Lunden} arc opens after you build the Hidden Ones Bureau at Ravensthorpe and talk to @npc{Hytham}.

steps.text: Build the Hidden Ones Bureau at Ravensthorpe and speak to Hytham.
Pledge to Lunden at the alliance map, then finish its story quests.

achievements.description: Complete the East Anglia story arc.
achievements.summary: Complete the East Anglia story arc.

guide.context: The arc unlocks after the Ledecestrescire and Grantebridgescire arcs, once you repel the raid on Ravensthorpe.

steps.text: Finish the Ledecestrescire and Grantebridgescire arcs and repel the attack on Ravensthorpe.
Pledge to @loc{East Anglia} at the alliance map and complete its story missions.

achievements.description: Finish the Cent arc of the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete the Cent story arc.

steps.text: Pledge to Cent at the alliance map and finish its story quests.

achievements.description: Finish the Suthsexe arc of the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete the Suthsexe story arc.

steps.text: Pledge to @loc{Suthsexe} at the alliance map and complete its story missions.

achievements.description: Finish the Wincestre arc of the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete the Wincestre story arc.

guide.context: Wincestre's story belongs to the Order of the Ancients thread, so finishing it also advances Disorder of the Ancients.

steps.text: Pledge to @loc{Wincestre} at the alliance map and finish its story quests.

achievements.displayName: In the Footsteps of the Gods
achievements.description: Finish the mythological story arcs of Asgard and Jotunheim.
achievements.summary: Complete the Asgard and Jotunheim story quests.

guide.context: Build the Seer's Hut and finish Valka's missions to open both realms. Take the green potion for Asgard and the blue potion for Jotunheim from Valka's Hut; Jotunheim unlocks after the quest "The Big Finish".

steps.text: Build the Seer's Hut at Ravensthorpe and complete the quests @npc{Valka} gives you.
Drink the Asgard potion in Valka's Hut and finish the Asgard chapters.
Drink the Jotunheim potion after "The Big Finish" and finish the Jotunheim chapters.
steps.note: To return to England, use the eye icon on the map and hold the prompt to choose "Wake up".

achievements.description: Complete "The Prophecy" storyline in Norway.
achievements.summary: Complete "The Prophecy" questline in Hordafylke.

guide.context: This storyline opens after the Wincestre arc. Pledge to Norway from the alliance map; the Hordafylke territory sits below the England map, so scroll down to find it.

steps.text: Talk to @npc{Randvi} and open the alliance map.
Scroll below England to @loc{Hordafylke} and pledge to Norway.
Finish "The Prophecy" questline.

achievements.description: Complete the Hamtunscire arc that ends the main story.
achievements.summary: Complete the Hamtunscire story arc.

guide.context: Hamtunscire is the final England arc and closes the main story.

steps.text: Pledge to @loc{Hamtunscire} at the alliance map and complete its story quests.

achievements.description: Eliminate all 45 Order of the Ancients targets.
achievements.summary: Eliminate all 45 Order of the Ancients targets, including its 30 Wardens and 15 Zealots.

guide.context: The Order is made of 30 Wardens and 15 Zealots; 13 fall during the story. Reveal a Warden by gathering clues, then mark the target from the Order tab. Zealots patrol the region roads and are revealed once you get within 40-50 m.

steps.text: Kill the 13 Order members that the story sends you after.
Gather clues to reveal each remaining Warden, mark the target from the Order tab, and assassinate them.
Hunt the 15 Zealots on the roads; killing one can reveal a linked Warden.
Report the completed hunt to @npc{Hytham} in the Hidden Ones Bureau.

achievements.description: Complete your first monastery raid in England.
achievements.summary: Complete your first monastery raid in England.

guide.context: Raiding opens after you claim Ravensthorpe. @loc{Alcestre Monastery} in Ledecestrescire, about 900 m west of the settlement, is the closest first target.

steps.text: After claiming Ravensthorpe, accept "Settling Down" from @npc{Gunnar}.
Travel to Alcestre Monastery in Ledecestrescire.
Enter on foot and choose Start Raid, or sail the longship into the dock and choose Raid.
Open every treasure chest in the monastery to finish the raid.

achievements.description: Create your own Jomsviking raider at Ravensthorpe.
achievements.summary: Create a Jomsviking at the settlement barracks.

guide.context: The @loc{Barracks} costs 400 Supplies and 30 Raw Materials. The Crew Master at its entrance handles creation.

steps.text: Build the Barracks at Ravensthorpe.
Talk to the @npc{Crew Master} at the barracks entrance.
Choose equipment and appearance, then confirm with the Assign button.

achievements.description: Complete a Standing Stone puzzle
achievements.summary: Solve one Standing Stone puzzle.

guide.context: Standing Stones are region Mysteries and there are 13 of them. Any single puzzle unlocks the achievement.

steps.text: Reach the center of a Standing Stones circle and read the stone to see the pattern.
Use @mechanic{Odin's Sight} to highlight the stone carvings.
Find the camera position that lines the carvings up with the pattern.

achievements.description: Complete 3 Cairn challenges
achievements.summary: Complete 3 Cairn challenges.

guide.context: Cairns are region Mysteries and there are 13 in total. Only three are needed for the achievement.

steps.text: Find a Cairn on high ground and interact with the rocks to begin.
Stack the rocks into a stable pile that reaches the marked height.
Validate the pile once the zone turns orange.

achievements.description: Collect 5 Treasure Hoard rewards (Base game only)
achievements.summary: Claim the treasure from 5 different Treasure Hoard Maps.

guide.context: Hoard Maps are region Artifacts in England and Norway. Reading a map alone does not count; you must dig up the treasure it points to.

steps.text: Collect a Treasure Hoard Map, then open it from the Inventory bag to read its sketch.
Go to the sketched location and dig up the treasure.
Repeat until 5 treasure rewards have been claimed.

achievements.description: Perform a 150m slide in the snow
achievements.summary: Slide 150 meters down the snow slope in Rygjafylke.

guide.context: Only one downhill stretch in @loc{Rygjafylke}, Norway, is long enough; it measures just over 150 m.

steps.text: Travel to the marked downhill section in Rygjafylke, Norway.
Sprint into the slide and ride it to the bottom without stopping.

achievements.description: Defeat one Daughter of Lerion
achievements.summary: Defeat one Daughter of Lerion.

guide.context: The 3 sisters are region Mysteries. Goneril (power 90) waits at Spalda Fens in Grantebridgescire and is the easiest; Regan (power 110) is at Walsham Crag and Cordelia (power 340) at Berkelow Bog, both in East Anglia.

steps.text: Travel to Spalda Fens in Grantebridgescire and start the fight with @enemy{Goneril}.
Dodge her attacks and her duplicate, then wear her down with light attacks.
steps.note: Bring plenty of rations and arrows; these fights are harder than Zealots.

achievements.description: Assassinate an enemy from your horse
achievements.summary: Assassinate an enemy while mounted on your horse.

guide.context: Tap the crouch button on the horse to stand up; the assassination prompt appears when you are behind an unaware target.

steps.text: Mount your horse and press the crouch button to stand on its back.
Ride up behind an unaware enemy and use the assassination prompt.
steps.note: The straw puppets at the Hidden Ones Bureau also work; hit one first if the prompt does not show.

achievements.description: Assassinate 10 enemies in a row without triggering a conflict
achievements.summary: Take down 10 enemies in a row by stealth, without being spotted or entering combat.

guide.context: Only melee assassinations count; bow takedowns do not. The streak resets the moment you are spotted or combat begins.

steps.text: Choose a spot with many lone guards, such as Ravensburg in Grantebridgescire or Ledecestre in Ledecestrescire.
Take guards down one by one from cover without being seen.
Keep the streak going until 10 have fallen.
steps.note: The Chain Assassination skill helps but is optional; its second target must stand a few meters away.

achievements.description: Complete 10 World Events
achievements.summary: Complete 10 World Events.

guide.context: World Events are the markerless side stories that count as region Mysteries; 129 exist across the regions.

steps.text: Find a World Event, usually by speaking to an NPC in the wild.
Follow what the NPC asks and finish the event.
Repeat until 10 World Events are complete.
steps.note: Listen to the dialogue and use Odin's Sight to find the objects an event needs.

achievements.description: While on fire during a fight, kill 3 hard difficulty soldiers without breaking their shields
achievements.summary: Kill 3 out-levelled soldiers with a red skull while on fire during one fight, without breaking their shields.

guide.context: A red-skull soldier is at least 40 power above you, not a difficulty setting. Werham in Hamtunscire (power 340) has Standard Bearers that work well.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Werham} in Hamtunscire and enter the town so the Standard Bearers show red skulls.
steps.note: Stay under power 300; reset your skill points from the menu if you are higher. Set combat difficulty to easy.

steps.text: Weaken 3 soldiers to low health with a bow, taking care not to break their shields.
Catch fire from a torch at the straw or the enemies' fire bombs and wait for the fire meter to fill.
steps.note: Do not leave combat between kills or the count resets.

steps.text: Kill a weakened soldier while burning, re-light as needed, and repeat until 3 die.

achievements.description: Complete all territories
achievements.summary: Collect every Wealth, Mystery, and Artifact in all base-game territories.

guide.context: Progress is tracked per region in the bottom-right corner of the world map. Wealth is gold, Mysteries blue, and Artifacts white. Nothing is missable with patch 2.00 or later, so anything skipped can be finished in free roam.

steps.text: Synchronize the viewpoints in a region to reveal its collectibles on the map.
Complete every Wealth, Mystery, and Artifact in that region.
Repeat across Norway, England, Asgard, Jotunheim, and Vinland until all are checked off.
steps.note: Orlog players, raids, and viewpoints are not required for this achievement.

achievements.description: Ram and destroy 5 boats in under 2 minutes with your longship (Base game only)
achievements.summary: Ram and destroy 5 boats with your longship within 2 minutes.

guide.context: The longship needs real speed to break a boat instead of just pushing it. Open the sail shortly before impact.

steps.text: Call the longship near the @loc{Lincoln} docks in Lincolnscire and open the sail.
Steer straight into small boats at full speed.
Keep moving forward and sink 5 boats before 2 minutes pass.

achievements.displayName: We're in the End Game Now
achievements.description: Reach Power 280
achievements.summary: Reach power level 280.

guide.context: The story grants roughly 180 skill points; the rest come from XP, Mysteries, raids, and Order kills. Skill points can be reset for free at any time.

steps.text: Earn skill points from quests, enemies, Mysteries, and raids.
Spend points in the skill tree until your power reaches 280.

achievements.description: Smash 30 breakable objects while sprinting.
achievements.summary: Sprint through 30 breakable objects.

guide.context: The Sprint Bash skill, near the top right of the Bear branch of the skill tree, lets a sprint smash objects.

steps.text: Unlock the @mechanic{Sprint Bash} skill on the Bear branch of the skill tree.
Sprint straight into jars, wooden fences, or crates.
Break objects until 30 have been destroyed in total.

achievements.description: Reach settlement level 3
achievements.summary: Reach settlement level 3 at Ravensthorpe.

guide.context: Some region arcs, such as East Anglia and Lunden, award settlement levels automatically. You can also build 7 upgrades using raided resources.

steps.text: Finish region arcs that grant settlement levels, or raid monasteries for Supplies and Raw Materials.
Build or upgrade settlement structures until the level reaches 3.

achievements.description: Reach settlement level 6
achievements.summary: Reach settlement level 6 at Ravensthorpe.

guide.context: The story arcs alone bring the settlement to level 4. The last levels need every building bought and fully upgraded.

steps.text: Complete the region arcs that grant settlement levels.
Build every structure at Ravensthorpe and upgrade each one that supports it.
steps.note: A building is fully upgraded when no build post remains at its entrance. Raiding every monastery provides enough Raw Materials.

achievements.description: Reach the Vinland territory during the Order of the Ancients hunt.
achievements.summary: Reach Vinland for the first time.

guide.context: Vinland opens during the hunt for Gorm Kjotvesson. You must first kill the 6 Order members of the right branch, then take the quest "In a Strange Land" and report to Hytham.

steps.text: Kill the 6 Order of the Ancients members on the right branch.
Take the quest "In a Strange Land" and report to @npc{Hytham}.
Talk to @npc{Randvi}, scroll below the England map, and pledge to Vinland.
Speak to the woman at the docks to sail there.
steps.note: All gear and weapons are left behind on the voyage and returned when you travel back to England.

achievements.description: Place an item on each settlement cosmetic spot (Base game only)
achievements.summary: Place a decoration on all 16 settlement cosmetic spots.

guide.context: The spots are the totems around Ravensthorpe. The same decoration can be reused on every one, and some spots only appear after more buildings are built and leveled up.

collectibles.location: Behind Kari's house.

achievements.displayName: Not the Norse You're Looking For
achievements.description: Successfully pass close to a guard in a distrust area by blending with a group of monks
achievements.summary: Pass a guard in a distrust area while blended with monks.

guide.context: Distrust areas show an orange bar at the top of the screen and equip the cloak automatically. Good spots are St. Peter's church in Wincestre and the pond in central Colcestre, Essexe.

steps.text: Enter a distrust area and keep the cloak on.
Use Odin's Sight to find a group of monks, then blend in with them.
Walk with the monks until you pass a guard closely.

achievements.description: Equip 8 abilities
achievements.summary: Equip an ability in all 8 ability slots.

guide.context: There are 4 melee and 4 ranged slots, and the abilities do not have to be different. Abilities come from knowledge books or from Hytham after Order medallions.

steps.text: Collect knowledge books around the regions, or learn abilities from @npc{Hytham}.
Open the Abilities tab in the menu.
Place one ability in each of the 4 melee and 4 ranged slots.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade and enhance a piece of gear
achievements.summary: Upgrade one piece of gear to Mythical tier with all 10 slots filled.

guide.context: Mythical quality needs 1 Tungsten Ingot at the Blacksmith. Filling the slots needs Leather, Iron Ore, Fabric, and Titanium; an upgradeable item shows a white arrow on its icon.

steps.text: Collect ingots and crafting materials from Wealth chests, animals, and merchants.
Enhance one piece of gear to Mythical at the Blacksmith.
Fill all 10 upgrade slots from the Inventory menu.
steps.note: Runes are not required for the achievement.

achievements.description: Get thrown 30 meters away by a destroyer or a housecarl
achievements.summary: Get thrown 30 meters by a destroyer or housecarl.

guide.context: The game labels these enemies Goliath. The Goliath on the pillar at Venonis in Ledecestrescire is a reliable spot.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Venonis} in Ledecestrescire and find the Goliath on the pillar with @mechanic{Odin's Sight}.
Climb to the top and let him use his grab-and-throw attack.
steps.note: Save first; he can fall off the pillar and die.

achievements.description: Release a firefly in your settlement
achievements.summary: Catch a firefly and release it at your settlement.

guide.context: Fireflies appear at night around old ruins and abandoned buildings. Use Meditate from the item wheel to reach night.

steps.text: Catch a firefly at night around ruins or the building near Ravensthorpe that holds a Roman Artifact.
Return to the pond by the Seer's Hut at Ravensthorpe.
Use the Release Firefly prompt at the pond's edge.
steps.note: If no firefly appears, exit the Animus and re-enter to make them respawn.

achievements.description: Complete all Roman collector challenges
achievements.summary: Return all 52 Roman Artifacts to Octavian.

guide.context: Build the Museum at Ravensthorpe, talk to Octavian, and finish the quest he gives in Lunden. Collecting the artifacts is not enough; they must be handed in.

steps.text: Build the Museum at Ravensthorpe and speak to @npc{Octavian}.
Complete the quest he gives you in @loc{Lunden}.
Collect all 52 Roman Artifacts across England and hand them back in batches.

achievements.description: Beat all the Orlog players
achievements.summary: Beat all 19 Orlog players in England and Norway.

guide.context: Orlog is a dice game. A steady approach is to pick Thor's Strike as God Favor, keep only gold-bordered and hand dice, then spend 12 favor tokens on 8 damage.

collectibles.location: Stavanger harbor, southwest shore, Rygjafylke.
collectibles.method: Challenge and beat them at Orlog.

collectibles.method: Challenge and beat them at Orlog.

collectibles.location: Wincestre, next to the drinking challenge.
collectibles.method: Challenge and beat them at Orlog.

collectibles.name: Fearnhamme player
collectibles.location: Fearnhamme, near the eastern border with Suthsexe, Hamtunscire.
collectibles.method: Challenge and beat them at Orlog.

achievements.description: Catch a fish of each type using the fishing line
achievements.summary: Catch one fish of each of the 19 types with the fishing line.

guide.context: Build the Fishing Hut and talk to Arth to learn fishing, then cast the line from the action wheel. Killing fish with melee or explosives does not count.

collectibles.name: Halibut
collectibles.location: Coasts off Grantebridgescire, East Anglia, Lincolnscire, and Eurvicscire.
collectibles.method: Catch with the fishing line.

collectibles.name: Salmon
collectibles.location: Rivers of Lincolnscire, Eurvicscire, and Snotinghamscire.
collectibles.method: Catch with the fishing line.

achievements.description: Spend your first Mastery point
achievements.summary: Spend your first Mastery point.

guide.context: Mastery points appear after you reach level 400 with every skill node filled; each later skill point becomes a Mastery point.

steps.text: Reach level 400 and unlock all skill nodes.
Spend a point in one of the three Mastery nodes beside the central node.

achievements.description: Light the unlit braziers on Hadrian's Wall
achievements.summary: Light all 10 unlit braziers along Hadrian's Wall.

guide.context: Hadrian's Wall runs along England's northern edge. Most braziers sit along the wall; the last one is on a tall stone building at the coast end.

steps.text: Travel to the fast travel point north of Eurviscire.
Follow the wall east and light each brazier with a torch.
steps.note: The final brazier is off the wall itself, on the tall stone structure at the coast; climb up to light it.

achievements.description: Complete all the flytings
achievements.summary: Win all 16 flyting challenges.

guide.context: Flytings count as region Mysteries except the tutorial against Alvis in Fornburg, who later waits at Ravensthorpe. You must win, and some duels require a silver bet of 100, 150, or 200.

collectibles.name: Alvis
collectibles.location: Fornburg, Rygjafylke, Norway.
collectibles.method: Win a flyting; match rhyme, timing, and topic.

collectibles.name: Manning, Fighter of Wolves
collectibles.location: Stavanger, Rygjafylke, Norway.
collectibles.method: Win a flyting; match rhyme, timing, and topic.

collectibles.name: Jungul
collectibles.location: Repton, Ledecestrescire.
collectibles.method: Win a flyting; match rhyme, timing, and topic.

collectibles.name: Fergal the Faceless
collectibles.location: Grantebridge, Grantebridgescire.
collectibles.method: Win a flyting; match rhyme, timing, and topic.

collectibles.name: Chadwick, Monger of Gossip
collectibles.location: Northwic, East Anglia.
collectibles.method: Win a flyting; match rhyme, timing, and topic.

collectibles.name: Augusta the Cheerful
collectibles.location: Lunden stables.
collectibles.method: Win a flyting; match rhyme, timing, and topic.

collectibles.method: Win a flyting; match rhyme, timing, and topic.

collectibles.method: Win a flyting; match rhyme, timing, and topic.

collectibles.method: Win a flyting; match rhyme, timing, and topic.

collectibles.location: Center of Asgard.
collectibles.method: Win a flyting; match rhyme, timing, and topic.

collectibles.name: Ratatosk
collectibles.location: By Thyrn's house, Jotunheim.
collectibles.method: Win a flyting; match rhyme, timing, and topic.

achievements.description: Draw the legendary sword Excalibur from the stone.
achievements.summary: Draw Excalibur from the stone in Myrddin's Cave.

guide.context: Excalibur needs 11 Mysterious Stone Tablets: 8 from the end of Treasure of Britain caves and 3 carried by the Zealots Woden, Heike, and Hrothgar. Myrddin's Cave is in Hamtunscire.

collectibles.name: Grime's Graves tablet
collectibles.location: Treasure of Britain cave at Grime's Graves, north of the Britannia's Watch fast travel point, East Anglia.
collectibles.method: Clear the cave and take the tablet at the end.

collectibles.name: Old Cellar tablet
collectibles.location: Old Cellar, southeast of Colcestre, Essexe.
collectibles.method: Clear the cave and take the tablet at the end.

collectibles.name: Cavern of Trial tablet
collectibles.location: Cavern of Trial, east of Cent before the cape.
collectibles.method: Clear the cave and take the tablet at the end.

collectibles.name: Santlache Mine tablet
collectibles.location: Santlache Mine, east of Crawleah, Suthsexe.
collectibles.method: Clear the cave and take the tablet at the end.

collectibles.name: Red Lichen Cavern tablet
collectibles.location: Red Lichen Cavern, east of Wincestre, Hamtunscire.
collectibles.method: Clear the cave and take the tablet at the end.

collectibles.name: Wocig tablet
collectibles.location: Wocig in Hamtunscire, east of the central western fast travel point.
collectibles.method: Clear the cave and take the tablet at the end.

collectibles.name: Wiccan's Cave tablet
collectibles.location: Wiccan's Cave, west of Jorvik, Eurviscire.
collectibles.method: Clear the cave and take the tablet at the end.

collectibles.name: Deoraby Spar Cavern tablet
collectibles.location: Deoraby Spar Cavern, northeast of Hemthorpe, Snotinghamscire.
collectibles.method: Clear the cave and take the tablet at the end.

collectibles.name: Woden's tablet
collectibles.location: Woden, a Zealot who patrols Cent.
collectibles.method: Kill the Zealot and take the tablet.

collectibles.name: Heike's tablet
collectibles.location: Heike, a Zealot who patrols Essexe.
collectibles.method: Kill the Zealot and take the tablet.

collectibles.name: Hrothgar's tablet
collectibles.location: Hrothgar, a Zealot who patrols Suthsexe.
collectibles.method: Kill the Zealot and take the tablet.

achievements.displayName: It's Not a Bug, It's a Feature!
achievements.description: Complete one Animus Anomaly platform puzzle.
achievements.summary: Complete your first Animus Anomaly.

guide.context: Animus Anomalies are region Mysteries and there are 10 of them. Each is a floating platform course that ends in a video fragment.

steps.text: Enter an Animus Anomaly, marked as a region Mystery.
Climb the floating course, keeping projector beams on grey structures and avoiding orange hazards.
Reach the top and claim the video fragment.

achievements.description: Swim 3 km in total while riding your horse.
achievements.summary: Swim a total of 3 km on your horse.

guide.context: Buy the horse swimming skill from a stable first; Grantebridge is the earliest easy stable. The distance adds up across sessions.

steps.text: Buy the swimming skill for your horse at a stable or horse trainer.
Ride into a river or the sea and swim.
steps.note: About 20 minutes of nonstop swimming covers 3 km.

achievements.description: Gather all Animus Anomaly fragments and watch the hidden video.
achievements.summary: Collect all 10 Animus Anomaly fragments and watch the hidden video.

guide.context: One video fragment sits at the top of each of the 10 Animus Anomalies. The full video plays once every clip is gathered.

steps.text: Complete all 10 Animus Anomalies across the regions.
Take the video fragment at the top of each one.
Open the video and watch it to the end.

achievements.description: Defeat all Alpha animals (Base game only)
achievements.summary: Defeat 10 Alpha animals in the base game.

guide.context: The settlement hunter's checklist leaves off O Yan Do' Ne, but that Vinland animal counts; Steinnbjorn in Jotunheim is the one that does not.

steps.text: Clear the Alpha animals that appear as region Mysteries on the world map.
Aim for weak points with a light bow and evade when a beast charges.

achievements.description: Destroy 10 Curse Symbols (Base game only)
achievements.summary: Destroy 10 Cursed Symbols in the base game.

guide.context: Cursed Symbols are counted as region Artifacts, so they also count toward full world completion; 40 exist, but only 10 must be destroyed.

steps.text: Hit or shoot the hidden rune-enchanted skull at each Cursed Symbol site.

achievements.description: Claim a hidden piece of Thor's armor.
achievements.summary: Obtain Thor's Helmet from the underground chest beneath Lerion's statue in East Anglia.

guide.context: The statue only opens once a dagger from each of the three Daughters of Lerion has been placed in it.

steps.text: Defeat the 3 @enemy{Daughters of Lerion}; each leaves a dagger.
Enter the underground structure in @loc{East Anglia}, about 400 m southeast of the @loc{Northwic} fast-travel point.
Reach the room with the Lerion statue and place a dagger in each of its three slits.
Descend the revealed stairs and loot the wealth chest for @item{Thor's Helmet}.

achievements.description: Claim Thor's hammer after assembling his armor.
achievements.summary: Wield @item{Mjolnir} in @loc{Hordafylke} with all five pieces of Thor's armor equipped.

guide.context: The set needs the three Daughters of Lerion pieces, Thor's Helmet, and Thor's Cloak from Hytham; visiting Hordafylke is easiest after the story opens the map.

steps.text: Collect all five pieces of @item{Thor's armor}: the three from the Daughters of Lerion, @item{Thor's Helmet}, and the cloak.
Eliminate all 45 @enemy{Order of the Ancients} targets and hand every medallion to @npc{Hytham} for @item{Thor's Cloak}.
Equip the full set, then pick up @item{Mjolnir} at its site in @loc{Hordafylke}.

achievements.description: Complete all territories of Ireland (Wrath of the Druids).
achievements.summary: Complete every Wealth, Mystery, and Artifact activity across the four regions of Ireland.

guide.context: Ireland holds 115 activities in total: 69 Wealth, 17 Mysteries, and 29 Artifacts.

steps.text: Clear all Wealth, Mysteries, and Artifacts in @loc{Dublin}, @loc{Meath}, @loc{Connacht}, and @loc{Ulster}.
Check the bottom-right of the world map for each region's remaining count.

achievements.description: Finish the Wrath of the Druids story.
achievements.summary: Complete the main storyline of the Wrath of the Druids expansion in Ireland.

guide.context: The campaign spans 18 quests across Dublin, Meath, Connacht, and Ulster, ending with The Cost of Betrayal.

steps.text: Play the DLC story through to the final quest @mechanic{The Cost of Betrayal}.

achievements.description: Collect amber shards from the Children of Danu.
achievements.summary: Collect an @item{Amber Shard} from each of the 10 Children of Danu in Ireland.

guide.context: Five members appear during the story and five are hunted with clues; each shard is looted automatically and the achievement pops on the tenth kill, so no return trip to Deirdre is needed.

steps.text: Eliminate the 5 @enemy{Children of Danu} met during the main story.
Mark the other 5 from the Order menu and hunt them down with their clues.

achievements.description: Complete a Trial of the Morrigan (Wrath of the Druids).
achievements.summary: Complete one Trial of the Morrigan in Ireland.

guide.context: Trials of the Morrigan are region Mysteries shown with a blue icon; six exist.

steps.text: Activate a @mechanic{Trial of the Morrigan} altar and defeat the Druids it summons.

achievements.description: Reach the max level of Dublin Renown (Wrath of the Druids).
achievements.summary: Reach Dublin Renown level 5 by giving trade materials to @npc{Azar} in Dublin.

guide.context: Renown rises only through Azar's Trade Contracts; materials come from Trade Posts and pile up in the chest beside her.

steps.text: Capture the Trade Posts to collect Clothing, Texts, Delicacies, and Luxuries.
Empty the material chest beside @npc{Azar} in @loc{Dublin} and hand over materials until Renown reaches level 5.
Trade Posts produce materials over time, so empty the chest periodically.

achievements.description: Kill the only snake in Ireland (Wrath of the Druids).
achievements.summary: Kill the only snake in Ireland, hidden in the church west of @loc{Tara} in @loc{Meath}.

steps.text: Go to the abandoned church in the marshes west of @loc{Tara} in @loc{Meath}.
Enter the main door, turn left into the side room, and break the large jar among the wooden crates.
Kill the snake that appears.

achievements.description: Complete 10 Royal Demands (Wrath of the Druids).
achievements.summary: Complete 10 Royal Demands across Ireland.

guide.context: Six demands are finished automatically during the story, so four more are needed afterward.

steps.text: Finish the Royal Demands handed out during @mechanic{War Efforts} and @mechanic{The Northern Reach}.
Complete four more at the pigeon-coop markers on your captured Trade Posts.
Optional objectives can be failed; only completing the demand counts.

achievements.description: Equip a sickle in each hand.
achievements.summary: Equip a @item{Sickle} in both weapon slots.

guide.context: Only two Sickles exist in Ireland, and the achievement triggers as soon as both are equipped.

steps.text: Loot the @item{Ceremonial Sickle} from the wealth chest in southern @loc{Connacht}.
Kill @enemy{Black Stout}, the legendary beast in the north-east of @loc{Connacht}, for the @item{Bone Sickle}.
Equip one Sickle in each hand.

achievements.description: Assemble the full Dublin Champion armor set.
achievements.summary: Collect all five pieces of the Dublin Champion armor set.

guide.context: Three pieces are rewards for Dublin Renown levels 2, 4, and 5; the other two drop from Lost Drengrs in Connacht and Ulster.

steps.text: Raise @loc{Dublin} Renown to levels 2, 4, and 5 to be awarded the @item{Bracers}, @item{Cloak}, and @item{Helmet}.
Defeat the @enemy{Lost Drengr} on @loc{Downpatrick Head} off north-west Connacht for the @item{Breeches}.
Defeat the @enemy{Lost Drengr} on the north-east coast of Ulster for the @item{Body Armor}.

achievements.description: Get your first Gold Medal in Mastery Challenge (Part 1)
achievements.summary: Earn a Gold medal by scoring 1000 in any Mastery Challenge trial.

guide.context: Trials come in Combat, Range, and Stealth types at the Mastery Challenge shrines.

steps.text: Score 1000 in any single @mechanic{Mastery Challenge} trial.

achievements.description: Earn all Gold Medals available in Mastery Challenge (Part 1)
achievements.summary: Earn a Gold medal in all 15 trials at the five Mastery Challenge shrines.

guide.context: Each shrine holds one Combat, one Range, and one Stealth trial, and every one needs a perfect 1000.

steps.text: Score 1000 in every trial at all five @loc{Mastery Challenge} shrines.

achievements.description: Complete the Siege of Paris campaign (The Siege of Paris).
achievements.summary: Complete the main campaign of the Siege of Paris expansion.

guide.context: The DLC opens with Strangers Bearing Gifts in Ravensthorpe and runs for five chapters, ending with Homecoming.

steps.text: Play through all five chapters to the final quest @mechanic{Homecoming}.

achievements.description: Complete all territories of Francia (The Siege of Paris).
achievements.summary: Complete every Wealth, Mystery, and Artifact activity in the four regions of Francia.

guide.context: Francia holds 69 activities: 40 Wealth, 20 Mysteries, and 9 Artifacts.

steps.text: Clear all Wealth, Mysteries, and Artifacts in @loc{Melunois}, @loc{Amienois}, @loc{Evresin}, and @loc{Paris}.
Watch the bottom-right region counters on the world map.

achievements.description: Defeat all three Frankish Nobles (The Siege of Paris).
achievements.summary: Defeat the three Frankish Nobles in Melunois, Amienois, and Evresin.

guide.context: Each noble is a region Mystery duel: Amric fights at range, Herbert can be assassinated outright, and Gerswinda leads two cavalry guards.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Amric "The Hunter"} near @loc{Les Trois Pignons} in @loc{Melunois}.
Assassinate @enemy{Herbert du Lilibone} north-west of @loc{Coteaux de la Seine} in @loc{Amienois}.
Defeat @enemy{Gerswinda "The Cavalier"} and her two guards at @loc{Les Champs Bleus} in @loc{Evresin}.

achievements.description: Reach maximum Infamy in the Rebel Missions (The Siege of Paris).
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum Infamy of level 4 with Rebel Missions in Francia.

guide.context: Infamy level 4 is the maximum and needs 20 finished missions: 1 to reach level 2, 7 more to level 3, and 12 more to level 4.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Pierre} in @loc{Melun} and unlock the @mechanic{Vive la Résistance} questline after the Francia prologue.
Complete 20 Rebel Missions from Pierre or any rebel marked on the map.
Missions marked Nearby are the quickest, and repeats still raise Infamy.

achievements.description: Enter the Assassin Bureau in Francia (The Siege of Paris).
achievements.summary: Enter the Assassin Bureau in Francia after finding its three keys.

guide.context: The keys sit at the end of Excavation mysteries; after the first, the quest Hidden marks the remaining two, and the Amienois key needs Explosive Arrows.

steps.text: Loot the three @item{bureau keys} from the @mechanic{Excavation} mysteries in @loc{Melunois}, @loc{Amienois}, and @loc{Evresin}.
Track the @mechanic{Hidden} quest once the first key is claimed.
Open the door marked with the Assassin insignia in the @loc{Lutetia Bureau} and step inside.

achievements.description: Defeat the Ghost Auroch Boss (The Siege of Paris).
achievements.summary: Defeat the Ghost Auroch south of Amiens in Amienois.

guide.context: The Ghost Auroch is a level 400 legendary animal that flees to a distant spot twice, with no time limit.

steps.text: Reach the Legendary Animal mystery about 250 m south of @loc{Amiens}.
Defeat the @enemy{Ghost Auroch}, dodging to its side to avoid horns and kicks.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a scythe while wearing the full Reaper armor set (The Siege of Paris).
achievements.summary: Equip the complete Reaper armor set, then kill an enemy with a scythe.

guide.context: The five Reaper pieces unlock as Infamy climbs to level 4, and no other weapon may be carried when the killing blow lands.

steps.text: Fill all five @item{Reaper armor} slots with pieces bought from @npc{Pierre}'s shop and the bracers granted at Infamy level 3.
Get a @item{scythe} during the quest @mechanic{Majesty in the Dark} or from the wealth chest at @loc{Pontem} in Amienois.
Equip only the scythe alongside the full set and kill an enemy.

achievements.description: Pat all the cats in Evreux (The Siege of Paris).
achievements.summary: Pet each of the four cats in Evreux.

guide.context: Eivor's hood must be off, sleeping cats cannot be petted, and traveling away and back respawns them.

steps.text: Go to @loc{Evreux} in @loc{Evresin} and look south from the fast-travel point to the market square.
Pet the two cats by the stalls, the black cat behind the house on the left, and the cat inside the house with the wooden door near the southern edge.
Meditate until morning if the cats are asleep.

achievements.description: Complete 10 Rebel Missions (The Siege of Paris).
achievements.summary: Complete 10 Rebel Missions in Francia.

guide.context: These missions also feed the Infamy climb that caps at level 4.

steps.text: Complete 10 @mechanic{Rebel Missions} from @npc{Pierre} or the rebel agents.

achievements.description: Complete one Tomb of the Fallen
achievements.summary: Complete Magnius' Sanctum, the Tomb of the Fallen outside Ravensthorpe.

guide.context: Tombs open from a rune-marked hidden entrance that your raven can spot from the air.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{your raven} to find the rune marking the hidden entrance just outside @loc{Ravensthorpe}.
Inspect the rune, enter @loc{Magnius' Sanctum}, and reach the end of the tomb.

achievements.description: Complete three Tombs of the Fallen
achievements.summary: Complete three of the four Tombs of the Fallen in England.

guide.context: The four tombs are @loc{Magnius' Sanctum}, @loc{Boudicca Tomb}, @loc{Cassivellaunus Tomb}, and @loc{Venutius Tomb}.

steps.text: Complete @loc{Magnius' Sanctum}, the tomb just outside @loc{Ravensthorpe}.
Use @mechanic{your raven} to spot the rune entrances, then clear two more of the four tombs.

achievements.description: Complete all territories of Svartalfheim (Dawn of Ragnarök)
achievements.summary: Complete every Wealth, Mystery, and Artifact activity in the four regions of Svartalfheim.

guide.context: Svartalfheim holds 179 activities: 93 Wealth, 31 Mysteries, and 55 Artifacts.

steps.text: Clear all Wealth, Mysteries, and Artifacts in @loc{Gullnámar}, @loc{Svaladal}, @loc{Vangrinn}, and @loc{Eitri}.
Hover each region on the world map to read its remaining count.

achievements.description: Complete the Dawn of Ragnarök campaign (Dawn of Ragnarök)
achievements.summary: Complete the main campaign of the Dawn of Ragnarök expansion.

guide.context: The DLC opens with Restless Dreams near Valka's Hut in Ravensthorpe and spans four story arcs.

steps.text: Play through the 18 quests of the four Svartalfheim story arcs.

achievements.description: Max out every Hugr-Rip upgrade.
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade the @item{Hugr-Rip} at a Shelter blacksmith.

guide.context: Maxing the Hugr-Rip takes 60 Silica plus Fragments and Muspelheim Embers.

steps.text: Receive the @item{Hugr-Rip} as a gift during @mechanic{Gift to the God}.
Raid the 10 @loc{Mylna} sites marked with crossed red axes for @item{Silica} and kill Jotun, Muspels, and Giant Ravens for @item{Fragments}.
Collect @item{Muspelheim Embers} from the nine @loc{Muspelheim Monoliths} using the Power of the Raven.
Spend the materials at a Shelter blacksmith until every upgrade is bought.

achievements.description: Perform a Tale for Kára with four Boasts.
achievements.summary: Complete a Tale for @npc{Kára} with at least four Boasts active.

guide.context: Each Boast is unlocked by a Heroic Saga artifact; 12 exist and four are enough for this.

steps.text: Collect at least four @item{Heroic Saga} artifacts to unlock four @mechanic{Boasts}.
Speak to @npc{Kára} in @loc{Svaladal}, activate four Boasts, and finish the Tale.

achievements.description: Kill 30 enemies with an Atgeir (Dawn of Ragnarök)
achievements.summary: Kill 30 enemies with an Atgeir equipped.

guide.context: The Impaler, an Atgeir, is awarded during Gift to the God.

steps.text: Equip an @item{Atgeir} and kill 30 enemies with it.

achievements.description: Discover all Shelters (Dawn of Ragnarök)
achievements.summary: Discover all four Shelters in Svartalfheim.

guide.context: Shelters are hidden hubs; orange arrows painted on carts, barrels, and rocks lead to a diveable underground cavern, and the Seeking Shelter quest covers three of them.

steps.text: Find the first Shelter during the early main story.
Track @mechanic{Seeking Shelter} and discover the Shelters in @loc{Gullnámar}, @loc{Svaladal}, and @loc{Vangrinn}.

achievements.description: Lift the curse from Hreidmar's armor.
achievements.summary: Purify all five pieces of Hreidmar's Cursed Armor.

guide.context: Each piece needs a Motsognir Clarity rune taken from one of the five Jotun Blight artifacts.

steps.text: Loot the five @item{Hreidmar's Cursed Armor} pieces from the room beside the blacksmith at @loc{Hodda Shelter} in Vangrinn.
Collect the five @item{Motsognir Clarity} runes from the Jotun Blight artifacts.
Socket a rune into each piece until all five are renamed Blessed.

achievements.description: Teleport-Assassinate two enemies and fly away without being detected (Dawn of Ragnarök)
achievements.summary: Teleport-Assassinate two enemies and escape with the Raven power unseen.

guide.context: Requires the Teleport-Assassinate upgrade and the upgrade that gives two Hugr-Rip charges, with the Jotunheim and Raven powers equipped.

steps.text: Buy the Teleport-Assassinate upgrade and the upgrade that grants two Hugr-Rip uses from one charge.
Equip the @mechanic{Power of Jotunheim} and @mechanic{Power of the Raven} on the @item{Hugr-Rip}.
Teleport-Assassinate two enemies, then fly out of the detection area with the Raven power.

achievements.description: Reach a Muspelheim Monolith (Dawn of Ragnarök)
achievements.summary: Set foot on one of the nine floating Muspelheim Monoliths.

guide.context: The Monoliths hang high above the map and need an upgraded Raven power to reach.

steps.text: Upgrade the @mechanic{Power of the Raven} duration or buy its two-charge upgrade.
Fly up and land on a @loc{Muspelheim Monolith}.

achievements.description: Earn all Gold Medals available in Mastery Challenge
achievements.summary: Earn a Gold medal in all 12 Reckoning Mastery Challenge trials.

guide.context: The last shrine opens only after the final boss fight, and finishing the first Mastery Challenges is required first.

steps.text: Finish every trial in the first Mastery Challenges to unlock the Reckoning shrines.
Score 1000 in every trial at the four shrines, including the shrine unlocked by the final boss.

achievements.description: Defeat Hel while wearing the Draugr's Toll set.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Hel} while wearing the @item{Draugr's Toll Outfit}.

guide.context: The outfit halves healing but raises damage as health drops, and it is earned from the Shifting Loyalties questline.

steps.text: Finish the @mechanic{Shifting Loyalties} questline to earn the @item{Draugr's Toll Outfit}.
Equip the outfit at @loc{Odin's Camp} and begin a new run.
Reach the fourth area and defeat @enemy{Hel}, killing her summoned dog first in each phase.

achievements.description: Reunite the dead within Kaldstad, Døkkerland and Nidheim (The Forgotten Saga)
achievements.summary: Complete the three reunion side quests in Kaldstad, Dókkerland, and Nidheim.

guide.context: Each quest needs several runs to finish; around seven runs in total is normal.

steps.text: Kaldstad: after the first lokkbox take the right path to the rope line, enter the cave, and beat the Shield Maiden; repeat this on three more runs.
Dókkerland: speak with the dwarf among the ruins, find the key with @mechanic{Odin's Sight}, free his brothers, then speak to him again on a new run and fight the enemies he spawns.
Nidheim: defeat @enemy{Slave Master Marrow} for @npc{Brodir}, then on later runs bring him 3 stones and beat the @enemy{Left Hand of Nidhogg}.

achievements.description: Defeat Nidhogg without using an Elk Shrine (The Forgotten Saga)
achievements.summary: Defeat the third-area dragon @enemy{Nidhogg} without touching an Elk Shrine on that run.

guide.context: Elk Shrines are golden elks that restore health and appear randomly; the ban covers the whole run, not just the fight.

steps.text: Start a fresh run and skip every @mechanic{Elk Shrine} from the first region onward.
Reach the third area and defeat @enemy{Nidhogg} by breaking its four paw bars before striking the glowing neck.
Bring a large health pool, the Dagger with Lightning Fury, and the Dwarven Defender armor.

achievements.description: Clear all encounters in the Dókkerland region.
achievements.summary: Complete all 11 encounters in the Dókkerland region.

guide.context: The final encounters and the second Hidden Merchant stay locked until the Dark Dealings quest is done.

steps.text: Finish the @mechanic{Dark Dealings} quest to gain the @item{Open Lines} favor and open the broken rope line.
Clear the 11 lokkbox encounters across the five Dókkerland sectors; progress carries between runs.

achievements.description: Knock 10 enemies off of ledges using the Kick of Tyr Ability (The Forgotten Saga)
achievements.summary: Knock 10 enemies off ledges with the Kick of Tyr ability.

guide.context: The ability appears at random in runs, so buying the Vivid Memory favor keeps it for the next run.

steps.text: Find the @mechanic{Kick of Tyr} ability during a run and set it to a melee slot.
Lure enemies to a ledge and kick 10 of them off; they do not have to die from the fall.

achievements.description: Find Hel's Majordomo (The Forgotten Saga)
achievements.summary: Find Hel's Majordomo in the fourth area of Niflheim.

guide.context: He waits beyond the encounters that power the teleport pads, past the Nidhogg fight.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Nidhogg} to open the fourth area.
Follow the encounters that unlock the teleport pads until @npc{Hel's Majordomo} appears, then talk to him.

achievements.description: Buy all of Nar's Favors at least once (The Forgotten Saga)
achievements.summary: Buy each of @npc{Nar}'s eight Favors at least once in Odin's Camp.

guide.context: The eight Favors are Elk Tracker, Silent Assist, Vivid Memory, Keepsake, Elk Herd, Inflated Currency, Awesome Advantage, and Famed Fortune.

steps.text: Earn Memories and Thoughts from bosses and cursed chests.
Buy every Favor from @npc{Nar} at @loc{Odin's Camp}; purchases can be split across runs.

achievements.description: Defeat Hel, ruler of Niflheim (The Forgotten Saga)
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Hel}, the final boss of Niflheim.

guide.context: Her fight has two phases, and she summons a dog in each one that should be killed first.

steps.text: Reach the fourth area and defeat @enemy{Hel}.

achievements.description: Return to Odin's Camp for the first time (The Forgotten Saga)
achievements.summary: Return to Odin's Camp after dying for the first time in Niflheim.

guide.context: The Odin's Gain summary appears first, then the game sends you back to camp.

steps.text: Die once in @loc{Niflheim} and let the game return you to @loc{Odin's Camp}.

achievements.description: Complete all Tombs of the Fallen
achievements.summary: Complete every Tomb of the Fallen in England.

guide.context: This covers the four original tombs plus the Buried Knowledge additions: Verica's Tomb, Togodomnus' Tomb, and Eden Ring Station.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Magnius' Sanctum}, @loc{Boudicca Tomb}, @loc{Cassivellaunus Tomb}, and @loc{Venutius Tomb}.
Complete @loc{Verica's Tomb} in @loc{Hamtunscire} and @loc{Togodomnus' Tomb} in @loc{Suthsexe}.
Complete @loc{Eden Ring Station} beneath @loc{Ravensthorpe}, solving its sphere and shutdown puzzles.
A tomb only counts once its artifact is collected.
